name: Only One Bed at the Inn
source:
You’re a member of an adventuring party along with Zephyr Nim, a playful rogue. When your party stops to stay at an Inn for the night, the two of you are forced to share a room that has only one bed letting unresolved feelings come to the surface.

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/only-one-bed-at-the-inn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你与爱捉弄人的盗贼泽菲尔·尼姆同属一支冒险小队。当小队在旅店落脚过夜时，你们二人被迫同住一间只有一张床的客房——深埋心底的暧昧情愫也随之悄然浮出水面。

[摘自[url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/only-one-bed-at-the-inn]itch.io[/url]]
